issue: Bookings not appearing in admin panel after creation

root_causes.description: Bookings are created with fields like client_ids, items, total_amount but admin expects guest_name, guest_email, check_in, check_out
API returns raw database fields without mapping to admin UI expectations
Chrome extension errors (1Password, DeviceTrust) causing connection issues

current_bookings_table_structure.items: JSONB - contains type, itemId, quantity, unitPrice, totalPrice, dates

solutions.solution: Fix API endpoint to transform database fields

steps.description: Update GET /api/bookings to join with clients table and transform fields
changes: Join bookings with clients table on client_ids[0]

solutions.risk: LOW - only affects API response format

solutions.solution: Create database view for admin bookings

steps.description: Create a PostgreSQL view that flattens the bookings structure
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW admin_bookings AS SELECT b.id, c.name as guest_name, c.email as guest_email, c.phone as guest_phone, (b.items->0->>'type') as type, (b.items->0->>'itemId') as item_name, (b.items->0->'dates'->>'checkIn') as check_in, (b.items->0->'dates'->>'checkOut') as check_out, b.total_amount as total_price, b.status, b.payment_status, b.created_at FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN clients c ON b.client_ids[1] = c.id

steps.description: Add cache invalidation when bookings are created
changes: After successful booking creation, invalidate /api/bookings cache

tasks.action: Transform database fields to admin UI format
Create test booking and verify it appears in admin
Query admin_bookings view instead of bookings table

sql_queries.check_bookings_table_structure: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'bookings' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
sql_queries.check_clients_table_structure: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'clients' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
sql_queries.view_recent_bookings: SELECT id, client_ids, items, total_amount, status, payment_status, created_at FROM bookings ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
sql_queries.create_admin_view: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW admin_bookings AS SELECT b.id, c.name as guest_name, c.email as guest_email, c.phone as guest_phone, (b.items->0->>'type') as type, (b.items->0->>'itemId') as item_name, (b.items->0->'dates'->>'checkIn') as check_in, (b.items->0->'dates'->>'checkOut') as check_out, b.total_amount::numeric as total_price, b.status, b.payment_status, b.created_at FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN clients c ON b.client_ids[1] = c.id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC;

code_fixes.reason: Admin page expects flattened structure with guest_name, guest_email, etc. Database stores nested structure with client_ids and items array.
